neighbours.label: weight-loss and dieting advice: sustainable eating habits and not feeling deprived
fire: If you want to slim down for good, pick a way of eating you can keep up for years.
Crash diets fail because people end up starving and then binge on everything.
Swap the sugary snacks for fruit, and you won't miss them after a couple of weeks.
My nutritionist said cutting calories too hard would just make me hungry and cranky.
The best diet for losing weight is the one you can actually stick with.
I dropped fifteen pounds once I stopped banning my favourite foods entirely.
Instead of counting every calorie, try smaller plates and slower meals to shed weight.
Losing weight slowly makes it easier to keep the pounds off afterwards.
quiet: If you want to learn guitar for good, pick a practice routine you can keep up for years.
Cram sessions fail because students end up exhausted and then forget everything.
Swap the old light bulbs for LEDs, and you won't notice the difference after a week.
My accountant said cutting expenses too hard would just make me stressed and cranky.
The best language app is the one you can actually stick with.
I saved fifteen hundred dollars once I stopped buying coffee every morning.
Instead of checking every email, try setting two fixed times a day to read them.
Training slowly makes it easier to avoid injuries when running a marathon.

notes: Card: top examples are all weight-management advice ('You have to figure out what works', 'feeling deprived', 'sustainability'). Probe: diet advice 0.65-0.86, same advice frame for gardening 0.01, budgeting 0.17.
